text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: In the lead! Air Groove is in the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Across the generations, mother and daughter have woven a dream upon the turf! It's Air Groove! A new queen is born!
(WOOOOOOAAAAHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
…………Did I... win?
Did I—

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove—!! You were so cool!
Congrats on becoming the new Empress—!!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove, you're the besttt!!
Three cheers for the mother-daughter victory, hurraaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—That's right.
I am... the new queen. In that case!
(WOOOOOOAAAAHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Amazing—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
…………I want to be
imposing like that too――

I went to greet Air Groove
after she claimed a magnificent victory—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
We finally—made it this far.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I admit it. Even I,
at this moment—cannot hold back my emotions."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Because the sight my mother saw that day... I, too, was able to witness it just like this.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ……You did well too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However—you understand, do you not?
This is not the end. Rather, it is only the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Shuka Sho.
Let's not get ahead of ourselves and stay focused.
choice_data_list: Now that's a true new queen.
Now that's a true new queen.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph—
You've become somewhat dependable yourself, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Continue to unleash that power to the fullest.
...I have a little bit of expectation for you."

Saying so, Air Groove showed a smile
imbued with the aura of an empress.
